ei.title: Accumulation and Effect of Genome Mutations
ei.subject: 10월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Accumulation and Effect of Genome Mutations

fullPassage: In each round of genome copying in our body, there is still about a 70 percent chance that at least one pair of chromosomes will have an error. With each round of genome copying, errors accumulate. This is similar to alterations in medieval books. Each time a copy was made by hand, some changes were introduced accidentally; as changes stacked up, the copies may have acquired meanings at variance with the original. Similarly, genomes that have undergone more copying processes will have gathered more mistakes. To make things worse, mutations may damage genes responsible for error checking and repair of genomes, further accelerating the introduction of mutations. Most genome mutations do not have any noticeable effects. It is just like changing the i for a y in "kingdom" would not guarantee the word's readability. But sometimes a mutation to a human gene results in, for example, an eye whose iris is of two different colors. Similarly, almost everyone has birthmarks, which are due to mutations that occurred as our body's cells multiplied to form skin. If mutations are changes to the genome of one particular cell, how can a patch of cells in an iris or a whole patch of skin, consisting of many individual cells, be affected simultaneously? The answer lies in the cell lineage, the developmental history of a tissue from particular cells through to their fully differentiated state. If the mutation occurred early on in the lineage of the developing iris, then all cells in that patch have inherited that change.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) accumulate=쌓이다 (B) worse=더 나쁜 (C) inherited=물려받은
det.analysis:
❌ ① disperse — worse — inherited: (A) disperse(흩어지다)는 '복제할 때마다 오류가 쌓인다'는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② accumulate — worse — inherited: 원문 일치. 복제할 때마다 오류가 '쌓이고(accumulate)', 사태를 '더 나쁘게(worse)' 만들며, 모든 세포가 그 변화를 '물려받았다(inherited)'는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ accumulate — better — inherited: (B) better(더 좋게)는 복구 유전자가 손상돼 상황이 악화된다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ accumulate — worse — rejected: (C) rejected(거부한)는 '변화를 물려받았다'는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: accumulate(쌓이다) / worse(더 나쁜) / inherited(물려받은)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) accidentally=우연히 (B) damage=손상시키다 (C) simultaneously=동시에
det.analysis:
❌ ① deliberately — damage — simultaneously: (A) deliberately(고의로)는 손으로 베낄 때 '우연히' 변화가 생긴다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② accidentally — protect — simultaneously: (B) protect(보호하다)는 돌연변이가 오류 점검 유전자를 '손상시킨다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ accidentally — damage — separately: (C) separately(따로따로)는 많은 세포가 '동시에' 영향받는다는 질문 맥락과 반대
✅ ④ accidentally — damage — simultaneously: 원문 일치. 변화가 '우연히(accidentally)' 생기고, 돌연변이가 복구 유전자를 '손상시키며(damage)', 세포들이 '동시에(simultaneously)' 영향받는다는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: accidentally(우연히) / damage(손상시키다) / simultaneously(동시에)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) gathered=모은 (B) accelerating=가속하는 (C) early=이른/초기의
det.analysis:
✅ ① gathered — accelerating — early: 원문 일치. 복제를 더 많이 거친 유전체는 더 많은 실수를 '모으고(gathered)', 복구 유전자 손상은 돌연변이 도입을 '가속하며(accelerating)', 돌연변이가 '초기에(early)' 생기면 모든 세포가 물려받는다는 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② lost — accelerating — early: (A) lost(잃은)는 실수가 '모인다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ gathered — slowing — early: (B) slowing(늦추는)은 돌연변이 도입을 '가속한다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ gathered — accelerating — late: (C) late(늦은)는 '초기에' 생긴 변화가 모든 세포로 퍼진다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: gathered(모은) / accelerating(가속하는) / early(초기의)

questions.passage: In each round of genome copying in our body, there is still about a 70 percent chance that at least one pair of chromosomes will have an error. With each round of genome copying, errors accumulate. This is similar to alterations in medieval books. Each time a copy was made by hand, some changes were introduced accidentally; as changes stacked up, the copies may have acquired meanings at variance with the original. Similarly, genomes that have undergone more copying processes will have gathered more mistakes. To make things worse, mutations may damage genes responsible for error checking and repair of genomes, further accelerating the introduction of mutations. Most genome mutations do not have any noticeable effects. It is just like changing the i for a y in "kingdom" would not <u>guarantee</u> the word's readability. But sometimes a mutation to a human gene results in, for example, an eye whose iris is of two different colors. Similarly, almost everyone has birthmarks, which are due to mutations that occurred as our body's cells multiplied to form skin. If mutations are changes to the genome of one particular cell, how can a patch of cells in an iris or a whole patch of skin, consisting of many individual cells, be affected simultaneously? The answer lies in the cell lineage, the developmental history of a tissue from particular cells through to their fully differentiated state. If the mutation occurred early on in the lineage of the developing iris, then all cells in that patch have inherited that change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>guarantee</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: guarantee=보장하다 → ensure=보장하다, 확실하게 하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① ensure: ensure(보장하다)는 guarantee(보장하다)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ② delay: delay(지연시키다)는 보장과 무관
❌ ③ prevent: prevent(막다)는 보장과 반대 방향
❌ ④ ignore: ignore(무시하다)는 보장과 무관
det.tip: guarantee = ensure = 보장하다, 확실하게 하다

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 form의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

✅ ③ (A) 양식/서식 — (B) 형성하다: (A)는 진료 전 작성하는 '양식(form)', (B)는 세포가 새 피부 조직을 '형성한다(form)'는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
